title: Saƙar bead: peyote, bulo, herringbone da bezels

say: Saƙar bead: peyote, bulo, herringbone da bezels.

Wannan shi ne bidiyo don Module 3 na Ƙwararren Ƙwaƙwalwar Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwallon Ƙwaya na Ƙaƙwalwa na Ƙaƙwalwa ) ke yi.
Saƙa na bead yana gina masana'anta mai sassauƙa tare da allura da zare, dutsen dutse ɗaya a lokaci guda, ba tare da maɗauri ba.

say: Mataki na daya. Yi amfani da allura mai girman 10 ko 12 da kusan 1.5m na zaren, saboda zaren tsayin daka. Ƙara katako mai tsayi kusan 20 cm daga ƙarshe.

panel.heading: Lebur ko da-ƙidaya peyote
items: Yi amfani da zaren kusan mita 1.5 da kuma katako mai tsayi
Dauki madaidaicin adadin beads, misali. 10
Sahu 3: karba 1, tsallake 1, wuce ta 1
Sama beads sun fito; kasa beads zauna kasa
Kowane sabon layi: karba 1, ta hanyar dutsen dutse na gaba

say: Mataki na biyu. Dauki madaidaicin adadin beads, misali 10. Waɗannan sun zama layuka 1 da 2 tare.

say: Anan ga yadda ƙwararriyar ke tsarawa. Ifeoma a Onitsha tana da abokin ciniki mai wuyan hannu 15.5 cm wanda ke son faɗin peyote cuff 4 cm.

panel.heading: Tsara mai ƙirƙira ƙirar peyote cuff
items: Swatch 10 beads fadi da girman 1.3 cm
Rumbuna: 4 ÷ 0.13 = 30.8, haka 30 (ko da)
Layuka na 16 cm: 16 ÷ 0.08 = 200
Beads: 200 layuka × 15 = 3,000

say: Ta saƙa swatch ɗin gwaji mai faɗin beads 10 da tsayin layuka 20. Yana auna 1.3 cm faɗi kuma 1.6 cm tsayi.

say: Dumin tubali yayi kama da bulo a bango. Kuna haɗa allurar ku a ƙarƙashin gadojin zaren, ƙananan madaukai tsakanin beads. Fara kowane jere a gada na biyu kuma kowane jeri ya fi guntu dunƙule ɗaya, don haka triangle yana yin ƴan kunne masu gasa.

panel.heading: Brick, herringbone da bezel

cards.d: Kungiya ƙarƙashin gadoji na zaren, ba ta hanyar beads. Fara kowane jere a gada na biyu don raguwa da ɗaya.
Koyaushe ɗauki beads 2, gangara ƙasa ɗaya kuma sama na gaba. Haɓaka a ƙarshen kowane zagaye.
Ko da-ƙidaya tushe zagaye, peyote sama da bango, sannan ƙarami 15/0 beads don kama taksi.

say: Herringbone, wanda kuma ake kira Ndebele stitch, yana yin ginshiƙai waɗanda suka jingina bibiyu. Koyaushe ɗauki beads biyu, gangara ƙasa ɗaya kuma sama na gaba.
A cikin igiya tubular, tashi sama a ƙarshen kowane zagaye. Ba tare da haɓakawa ba, igiya ta karkace daga sarrafawa.

say: Ƙwararren bead ɗin yana riƙe da cabochon ta gefensa. Backstitch wani tushe zagaye tare da ko da adadin beads, yi aiki sama bango, sa'an nan kuma canza zuwa karami 15/0 beads. Suka ja bangon dutsen.

say: Duba kowane saƙa. Ɓoye ƙarshen zaren tare da hanyoyin zigzag, ba kulli a saman ba.
Yi 'yan kunne nau'i-nau'i a gefe, saboda abokan ciniki suna lura lokacin da gefuna ɗaya ya fi tsayi.
Ci gaba da ginshiƙan igiya madaidaiciya kuma a matse. Kuma girgiza kuma danna kowane bezel. Taksi sako-sako ne oda maidowa.

panel.heading: Kafin ka sayar da aikin saƙa
items: Ƙarshen zaren tare da hanyoyin zigzag, babu kullin saman
'Yan kunnen kunne da aka yi gefe da gefe, madauri suna daidaita
ginshiƙan igiya madaidaiciya, babu gibi
Bezel ya wuce girgiza kuma latsa gwajin

say: Don tunawa. A cikin peyote, wuce ta cikin beads kawai. A cikin dinkin bulo, fara daga gada ta biyu don raguwa.
A cikin herringbone, ɗauki beads biyu kuma ku tashi kowane zagaye. A cikin bezel, yi amfani da madaidaicin madaurin tushe, sannan ƙarami beads. Kuma shirya daga ma'auni mai ma'auni.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Peyote: ta cikin beads, kada a sauke beads
Brick: fara daga gada ta biyu don ragewa
Herringbone: 2 beads, kuma tashi kowane zagaye
Bezel: ko da tushe zagaye, sannan ƙarami beads
Ƙimar da aka auna tana ba da madaidaicin ƙididdiga

say: Ayyukan ku na wannan ƙirar: tsarin swatch na peyote da tsarin cuff, wasu ƴan kunnen triangle guda biyu, samfuran kashin herringa tare da tsarin igiya, da cabochon da aka saita a cikin bead ɗin bead. Ɗauki kowane ɗaya a gefen wani mai mulki.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan ku don wannan tsarin
